findings.problem: The enquiry falsely says it was sent; the contact link is a malformed mailto address, and the journal claims real guests without sample wording.
findings.correction: Keep realistic enquiry/contact flows, finish with an explicit demo-only/no-send result, and use truthful sample-content wording.
findings.evidence: All three engines show 'Your enquiry has been sent — we’ll be in touch soon'; book.html only prevents submission and opens a local overlay. mailto:Clementines.rkdb.nz has no @. Reviews says 'Real guests. Real memories.'

findings.problem: Property-specific Enquire buttons lose the chosen retreat.
findings.correction: Carry the selected retreat into the booking form.
findings.evidence: Clicking Enquire — Coastal arrives with Woodland Retreat selected; all four source links share the same unqualified booking URL.

findings.problem: Booking fields have unassociated labels, and native validation can scroll the invalid field behind the fixed header.
findings.correction: Associate all labels, give useful accessible errors and keep invalid/focused fields visible below the header.
findings.evidence: Axe label on guests/name/email and select-name on Retreat. Firefox/WebKit phone invalid-guest screenshots show 999 behind the header. Native required/email/max=6 validation does work.

findings.problem: Menu and gallery focus can reach background content; closed gallery controls remain tabbable; enquiry dialog does not contain/restore focus or close with Escape.
findings.correction: Use correct dialog semantics, hide/inert inactive content, contain and restore focus, and support Escape without losing existing gallery controls.
findings.evidence: Axe aria-hidden-focus. Menu Tab reaches a home card. Gallery Tab 1 reaches Back to top. Enquiry focus contained=false and Escape closes=false in all three engines.

findings.problem: Discover ignores reduced-motion preference and can stop responding to keyboard navigation after the menu is used.
findings.correction: Respect reduced motion, provide accessible scene navigation and reliable keyboard focus; retain the working return-to-top flow.
findings.evidence: Reduced-motion context records transform transition 1.5s. PageDown on the menu button after closing leaves the Discover track unchanged; follow-up remains on hero. Source key handler excludes every button/link.

findings.problem: Several small labels, non-home header links and the enquiry OK button fail contrast.
findings.correction: Use palette-consistent foreground/background colours that meet contrast requirements, including header states and confirmation controls.
findings.evidence: Axe: white header on warm white approximately 1.01–1.02:1; labels/card metadata3.91:1; eyebrow4.35:1; OK white on #91a68f2.60:1. Four default pages report contrast findings.

findings.problem: Several pages lack a main landmark, and current-page navigation indicators never activate.
findings.correction: Add semantic main regions and reliable current-page state/aria-current without changing the composition.
findings.evidence: Axe landmark-one-main/region on collection/booking and uncontained Home content. Inline nav checks compare bare filenames with query-bearing hrefs; activeNav inventory empty.

findings.problem: Four existing images are 2.3–2.9MB each, including the Discover hero and three guest portraits.
findings.correction: Optimise the existing assets with visual checking, lazy-load suitable below-fold imagery and version repaired assets.
findings.evidence: Pinned blobs: discover-hero2622752B, review-guest-01 2916599B,04 2408668B,07 2315265B. Entire WebP asset set18,223,312B. All four originals inspected and hashes matched.

findings.problem: Some descriptions/alternatives conflict with the imagery, and the booking Location copy is entirely clipped.
findings.correction: Align copy and alternatives with existing artwork, correct name/NZ spelling inconsistencies, and expose the Location information.
findings.evidence: Town described as a limestone cottage but shown as a modern multi-storey building. Home alt describes a woodland cabin while image shows a scenic sign. Booking photo labelled map; Location copy begins at card bottom1590.45 and ends1785.89 with overflow hidden. Hannah & Will alt versus Hannah & Jewel caption; favorite instead of favourite.
